gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that a TSV {@link StringTokenizer} created with no input (or with an empty input string) behaves as a tokenizer that holds no tokens.
ADDED i2: A factory instance must always be a fresh clone, never one of the shared prototype instances returned by the no-argument factory methods.
ADDED i3: Asserts that the given tokenizer contains no tokens: iteration in either direction yields nothing, the size is zero, and {@code next()} fails.
ADDED i4: A TSV tokenizer with no input has no tokens.
ADDED i5: A TSV tokenizer initialized with an empty string also has no tokens.
